name: Bloomburgs
description: In stark contrast to the Capital’s opulence, this district is stricken with poverty and defiant. Here, the marginalized refugees resist Imperial rule, showing their unyielding spirit, unbroken under oppression. Most people here either do physical labor or end up in crime, with many relying on the black market, with stolen items, smuggled goods, and elicits being sold in its labyrinthine alleys. Various sub-districts house diverse groups of refugees; the Ubelians maintain their southern barbaric traditions, the Kjörners cling to their northern Kolbjörn customs, and “The Worst” Area offers refuge for the worst criminals seeking to evade the Ironhand. The distaste for the Empire is omnipresent, making this district a sanctuary for subversives and rebels, with magic being taught in secret and masked vigilantes patrolling the streets, as no one trusts the Ironhands. Called “Slum Saviors,” they dispense their form of justice, each with their own agenda. Adventurers may either turn vigilantes or criminals in this district, sometimes forced to navigate its underworld to acquire restricted magical goods or remedies for unique curses and mystical ailments, as many magical products are illegal in the Empire.
